column1: # Phase 29 (F29-01) pinned SBOM determinism corpus.
# Small on purpose. The fixture exists to prove that the CycloneDX transform is
# a byte-deterministic pure function, and a multi-megabyte capture of the real
# 865-package workspace graph would make every future diff unreadable while
# proving exactly the same thing.
# cargo-metadata.json is a hand-authored `cargo metadata --format-version 1`
# document shaped like the real one. It deliberately contains:
#   - packages listed OUT of package-url order, so the ordering test cannot
#     pass vacuously against an input that happened to arrive sorted;
#   - absolute `file:///` package ids and `manifest_path` values, so the
#     no-path-leak test has something real to catch;
#   - one workspace member WITH a license (wcore-types) and one WITHOUT
#     (wcore-fixture-harness), mirroring the real workspace, where exactly two
#     of 865 packages declare no license and both are our own;
#   - one registry crate declaring only `license-file` and no SPDX expression
#     (ring), which must be marked unknown AND flagged rather than treated as
#     permissive;
#   - one version carrying build metadata (toml 1.1.2+spec-1.1.0), so the
#     package-url percent-encoding is exercised. Real: this workspace's locked
#     graph contains six such versions.
# expected-sbom.json is the byte-exact output of
#   wayland-release sbom --metadata cargo-metadata.json --output -
# generated on Hetzner Linux at lane/29-02 463e1c29, and reproduced digest-for-
# digest after transfer to macOS. Regenerate it ONLY when the document shape
# changes deliberately, and bump sbom::SBOM_TRANSFORM_VERSION when you do.
# Columns: name<TAB>bytes<TAB>sha256
cargo-metadata.json
expected-sbom.json
